messages.subject: Bayesian fraction of missing information
parts:
Hello,

I was just wondering - is there any information in the Stan manual/other docs on the 'Bayesian fraction of missing information' measure that is outputted to the console in the new Stan release?

I found the Nicolae et al. paper but couldn't find a reference in the Stan manual.

In particular I wanted to know how this is calculated in Stan?

Finally, do you have any examples where R-hat~ 1 doesn't work well as a measure of convergence? What are the different 'things' they measure?

Best,

Ben
